tv_engineering_department.3001 = {
	type = location_event
	title = empty_text
	desc = empty_text
	hidden = yes
	immediate = {
	if = { limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id target = 1 } } trigger_else = { always = no } NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_ritual_memory_by_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_memory_by_id target = 1 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_forgotten_site
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_id value = 1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id|1)" }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style value = local_var:tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value }
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value
	clear_saved_scope = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	owner ?= {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	}
	tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_ritual_revoke_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary }
	if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 6 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 5 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 4 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 3 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 2 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 1 }
	}
	owner ?= {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_has_plain_wonder value = 1 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 1 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 1 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 1 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|1)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 1 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 1 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_increment_old_level
	}
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level
	}
	owner ?= {
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.2010 days = 1 }
	}
	}
	}
}

	option = { name = TV_WONDER_RITUAL_ACK

	type = location_event
	title = empty_text
	desc = empty_text
	hidden = yes
	immediate = {
	if = { limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id target = 2 } } trigger_else = { always = no } NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_ritual_memory_by_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_memory_by_id target = 2 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_forgotten_site
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_id value = 2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id|2)" }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style value = local_var:tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value }
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value
	clear_saved_scope = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	owner ?= {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	}
	tv_wonder_triumphal_axis_ritual_revoke_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sun_king_axis }
	if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sun_king_axis value >= 6 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sun_king_axis value >= 5 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sun_king_axis value >= 4 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sun_king_axis value >= 3 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sun_king_axis value >= 2 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sun_king_axis value >= 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 1 }
	}
	owner ?= {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_has_plain_wonder value = 1 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 2 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 2 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 2 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|2)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 2 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 2 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_increment_old_level
	}
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level
	}
	owner ?= {
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.2010 days = 1 }
	}
	}
	}
}

	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_dome_consecration value >= 5 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 5 }
	}

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 4 }

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }

	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 11 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 11 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|11)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 11 }

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }

	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 25 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|25)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }

	}
	tv_wonder_royal_art_district_ritual_revoke_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_court_art_district }

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_court_art_district value >= 5 } }

tv_engineering_department.3107 = {
	type = location_event
	title = empty_text
	desc = empty_text
	hidden = yes
	immediate = {
	if = { limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id target = 107 } } trigger_else = { always = no } NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_ritual_memory_by_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_memory_by_id target = 107 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_forgotten_site
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_id value = 107 }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id|107)" }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style value = local_var:tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value }
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value
	clear_saved_scope = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	owner ?= {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	}
	tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_ritual_revoke_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_inaugurated }
	if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_machu_picchu_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 1 }
	}
	owner ?= {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_has_plain_wonder value = 1 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 107 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 107 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 107 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|107)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 107 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 107 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_increment_old_level
	}
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level
	}
	owner ?= {
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.2010 days = 1 }
	}
	}
	}
}

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }

	else_if = {

	}

	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 111 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }

	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 111 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }

	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 120 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 120 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|120)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 120 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 120 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_increment_old_level
	}
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level
	}
	owner ?= {
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.2010 days = 1 }
	}
	}

	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_notre_dame_de_paris_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 4 }
	}

	}

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_notre_dame_de_paris_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 1 }

	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 143 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }

	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 143 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }

	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style value = local_var:tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value }
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value
	clear_saved_scope = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	owner ?= {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	}
	tv_wonder_unique_changbai_mountain_altar_ritual_revoke_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_changbai_mountain_altar_inaugurated }
	if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_changbai_mountain_altar_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_changbai_mountain_altar_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_changbai_mountain_altar_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_changbai_mountain_altar_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_changbai_mountain_altar_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_changbai_mountain_altar_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 1 }
	}
	owner ?= {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_has_plain_wonder value = 1 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 148 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 148 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 148 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|148)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 148 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 148 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_increment_old_level
	}
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level
	}
	owner ?= {
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.2010 days = 1 }
	}
	}
	}

	}
	else_if = {

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_iberian_inquisition_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 1 }
	}
	owner ?= {

	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 152 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 152 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 152 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {

	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }

	}

	}
	tv_wonder_unique_temple_of_heaven_ritual_revoke_effect = yes

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_temple_of_heaven_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 5 }

	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 157 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }

	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_has_plain_wonder value = 1 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 161 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 161 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 161 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|161)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 161 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 161 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_increment_old_level
	}
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level
	}
	owner ?= {
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.2010 days = 1 }
	}
	}
	}

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id|166)" }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style value = local_var:tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value }
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value

	owner ?= {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	}
	tv_wonder_unique_camino_de_santiago_ritual_revoke_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_camino_de_santiago_inaugurated }
	if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_camino_de_santiago_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_camino_de_santiago_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 5 }
	}

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 1 }

	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 166 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }

	type = location_event

	desc = empty_text
	hidden = yes
	immediate = {
	if = { limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id target = 180 } } trigger_else = { always = no } NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_ritual_memory_by_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_memory_by_id target = 180 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_forgotten_site
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_id value = 180 }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id|180)" }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style value = local_var:tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value }
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value
	clear_saved_scope = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	owner ?= {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	}
	tv_wonder_unique_zamosc_ideal_city_ritual_revoke_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_zamosc_ideal_city_inaugurated }
	if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_zamosc_ideal_city_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_zamosc_ideal_city_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_zamosc_ideal_city_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_zamosc_ideal_city_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_zamosc_ideal_city_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_zamosc_ideal_city_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 1 }
	}
	owner ?= {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_has_plain_wonder value = 1 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 180 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 180 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 180 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|180)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 180 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 180 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_increment_old_level
	}
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level
	}
	owner ?= {
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.2010 days = 1 }
	}
	}
	}

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id|189)" }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style value = local_var:tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value }
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value
	clear_saved_scope = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	owner ?= {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	}
	tv_wonder_unique_bukhara_kalyan_minaret_ritual_revoke_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_bukhara_kalyan_minaret_inaugurated }
	if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_bukhara_kalyan_minaret_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_bukhara_kalyan_minaret_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_bukhara_kalyan_minaret_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_bukhara_kalyan_minaret_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_bukhara_kalyan_minaret_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 1 }
	}
	owner ?= {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_has_plain_wonder value = 1 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 189 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 189 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 189 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|189)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 189 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 189 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_increment_old_level
	}
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level
	}
	owner ?= {
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.2010 days = 1 }
	}
	}
	}

	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_fontainebleau_palace_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_fontainebleau_palace_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_fontainebleau_palace_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 1 }
	}
	owner ?= {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_has_plain_wonder value = 1 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 193 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 193 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 193 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|193)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 193 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 193 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }

	}

	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level
	}
	owner ?= {
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.2010 days = 1 }
	}

	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 203 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 203 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 203 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|203)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 203 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 203 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_increment_old_level
	}
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level
	}
	owner ?= {
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.2010 days = 1 }
	}

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id|208)" }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style value = local_var:tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value }
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value
	clear_saved_scope = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	owner ?= {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	}
	tv_wonder_unique_electoral_conference_hall_ritual_revoke_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_electoral_conference_hall_inaugurated }
	if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_electoral_conference_hall_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_electoral_conference_hall_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 3 }

	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 208 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {

	}
	tv_wonder_unique_beijing_imperial_granaries_ritual_revoke_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_beijing_imperial_granaries_inaugurated }
	if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_beijing_imperial_granaries_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_beijing_imperial_granaries_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 4 }
	}

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 3 }
	}

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 1 }
	}
	owner ?= {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_has_plain_wonder value = 1 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 231 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 231 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 231 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}

	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }

	}

	}
	owner ?= {

	hidden = yes
	immediate = {
	if = { limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id target = 240 } } trigger_else = { always = no } NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_ritual_memory_by_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_memory_by_id target = 240 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_forgotten_site
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_id value = 240 }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id|240)" }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = tv_wonder_forgotten_style value = local_var:tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value }
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_forgotten_style_value
	clear_saved_scope = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	owner ?= {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ritual_sync_country
	}
	tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_ritual_revoke_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated }
	if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
	limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level value = 1 }
	}
	owner ?= {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_has_plain_wonder value = 1 }
	if = {
	limit = { NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id target = 240 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 240 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 240 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	else = {
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_increment_old_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id|240)" }
	if = { limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_increment_old_level < local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 240 }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_plain_level_by_wonder_id key = 240 value = local_var:tv_wonder_plain_instance_level }
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_increment_old_level
	}
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_plain_instance_level
	}
	owner ?= {
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.2010 days = 1 }
	}
	}
	}
}

tv_engineering_department.4240 = {
	type = country_event
	title = TV_WONDER_RERITUAL_COMPLETE_TITLE
	desc = TV_WONDER_RERITUAL_COMPLETE_DESC
	outcome = positive
	option = { name = TV_WONDER_RITUAL_ACK
	if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 240 var:tv_wonder_project_mode ?= 3 has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_completed var:tv_wonder_site ?= { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated NOT = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_style_by_id target = 240 } } trigger_else = { always = no } } } }
	tv_wonder_ritual_apply_choice_effect = yes
	hidden_effect = { trigger_event_silently = tv_engineering_department.2004 }
	}
	}
}
